newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Minnesota crude unit shut by fire Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Minnesota crude unit shut by fire Tuesday.

text.p: A crude unit at Ashland Inc's St Paul Park, Minnesota, refinery was shut down by fire late Tuesday after a severe electrical storm swept through the area, a company spokesman said Wednesday.
The crude unit, one of several at the 69,000 barrel-per-day plant, is expected to go back online by later today," said spokesman Stan Lampe.

The fire started after a severe electrical storm fraught with lightening and tornado sightings swept through Minnesota between 10 p.m. and 11 p.m. CST late Tuesday, causing a power dip at the refinery.
"It is unclear if the outage caused the fire (in the crude unit) or if it was a lightening strike," said Lampe.
Lampe declined to give the unit's capacity.
In late May, a fire shut down a crude distillation unit at the plant for about 10 days, causing minor damage to some electrical equipment.
